title: TIDES: Implicit Time-Awareness in Selective SSMs

beats.text: State-of-the-art Mamba models fail instantly when real-world time intervals become irregular. Here is why.
beats.visual_focus: A digital clock glitching between random numbers while a neural network graph collapses.

visual_blueprint.title: THE TIME PARADOX
visual_blueprint.sub: Why Mamba breaks in the real world

motif_params.title: THE TIME PARADOX
motif_params.sub: Why Mamba breaks in the real world

beats.text: The villain is the discretization step. Mamba forces the model to lie about time, treating every gap as identical.
beats.visual_focus: A metronome swinging erratically, representing the forced discretization step.

beats.text: TIDES pivots the architecture. It locks the step size to physical reality, preserving the true time gap.
beats.visual_focus: A rigid, fixed-interval timeline snapping into place over the previous erratic one.

feynman_certification.listener_verdict: This is actually solid. You didn't waste my time with a 'Hey guys' intro, and you got straight to the technical bottleneck—the discretization step. I've been looking into SSMs lately, and the way you framed the 'lying to the model' part made the architectural shift to the diagonal state matrix click instantly. No cringe metaphors, just straight engineering trade-offs.

thriller_metadata.physical_analogy: A clock that changes its tick speed based on the weather, making it impossible to measure actual elapsed time.
thriller_metadata.paradigm_shift: Native handling of irregular time intervals without losing expressivity
